body:
It seems that the MP-RestClient (https://github.com/rsvoboda/tracing-sample/blob/master/src/main/java/org/acme/getting/started/ClientResource.java#L26) in the native mode is not instrumented with tracing. This results in a broken trace and missing span for the rest client. 

MP-OpenTracing TCK covers this use case however I am not sure if Quarkus runs the TCK in the native mode.

This class https://github.com/smallrye/smallrye-opentracing/blob/master/implementation/src/main/java/io/smallrye/opentracing/SmallRyeRestClientListener.java#L14 should enable tracing in the MP-RestClient.

Can somebody from Quarkus core team have a look at what is broken in the native mode?
@gsmet who is the best candidate for `Can somebody from Quarkus core team have a look at what is broken in the native mode?` ?

No idea :). @kenfinnigan usually organizes the effort regarding the REST Client.

/cc @phillip-kruger too
I've got a PR with a fix that I validated with the sample
